phase: Phase 0 (feasibility) and Phase 1 (baselines) and Phase 2 (pretrained super-resolution)
notice: Synthetic camera-grade masters reconstructed from an AI-generated source by classical interpolation (baselines) and by pretrained super-resolution (synthesised detail). None is a camera capture or camera RAW file and none contains recovered sensor measurements.

weights.name: swinir_m_x4_classical
weights.license: Apache-2.0 (SwinIR code and released weights, Liang et al. 2021)
weights.training_data: DF2K (DIV2K + Flickr2K), bicubic degradation, L1 loss
weights.commercial_use: Licence permits commercial use; DIV2K is published for academic research only, so commercial use of these weights is unresolved.
weights.description: Classical SR: reconstructs edges faithfully, keeps source texture, invents the least.

weights.description: Real-world SR: sharper edges and synthesised texture.

color.working_space: linear-light RGB, Rec.709/sRGB primaries, D65 white, float32

warnings: no embedded ICC profile; assumed sRGB (override with source_color_space)

storage.note: uncompressed upper bound; lossless compression usually reduces it

super_resolution.scale_handling: network at its native x4, then Lanczos-3 in linear light to the exact target size

preset.label: Mode A, conservative
preset.intent: Source consistency first: the fidelity network (pixel loss, no adversarial texture) and full low-frequency correction. Minimal invented texture; preferred for faces.

overlap_disagreement.unit: sRGB 8-bit code values, inside the crossfade zones
overlap_disagreement.low_frequency: difference smoothed with a Gaussian of 2 source pixels
overlap_disagreement.blend_error: low-frequency difference times the smaller blending weight: how far the crossfade can move the image from the better-placed tile (the soft-seam measure)

tiling.tile_basis: 60% of free CUDA memory at 33 kB per input pixel (SwinIR, float32)

weights.name: swinir_m_x4_classical
weights.license: Apache-2.0 (SwinIR code and released weights, Liang et al. 2021)
weights.training_data: DF2K (DIV2K + Flickr2K), bicubic degradation, L1 loss
weights.commercial_use: Licence permits commercial use; DIV2K is published for academic research only, so commercial use of these weights is unresolved.
weights.description: Classical SR: reconstructs edges faithfully, keeps source texture, invents the least.

source_projection.operator: residual at source size (area reduction), upsampled with Keys bicubic, linear light

seams.method: mean excess luma step (8-bit codes) across each boundary line over lines 4 to 12 px away, on samples where the content is flat across the line

interpolation_difference.unit: sRGB luma, 8-bit code values, |super-resolution - Lanczos| at output resolution

source_consistency.domain: sRGB-encoded values in [0, 1] at source resolution (area-average reduction)
source_consistency.lpips_note: not computed: LPIPS needs pretrained network weights, which Phase 0/1 does not download

preset.label: Mode B, balanced
preset.intent: Moderate detail reconstruction: the perceptual (adversarial) network for sharper edges and inferred texture, with full low-frequency correction so tone and colour stay on the source. Default for general scenes.

overlap_disagreement.unit: sRGB 8-bit code values, inside the crossfade zones
overlap_disagreement.low_frequency: difference smoothed with a Gaussian of 2 source pixels
overlap_disagreement.blend_error: low-frequency difference times the smaller blending weight: how far the crossfade can move the image from the better-placed tile (the soft-seam measure)

tiling.tile_basis: 60% of free CUDA memory at 33 kB per input pixel (SwinIR, float32)
